title: Mexican Cheese Fritters
description: A simple and delicious Mexican snack made with melted cheese, crunchy on the outside and gooey on the inside.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, mix together flour, cocoa powder and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the flour mixture to the cheese and stir until well combined.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the cheese mixture into the hot oil.
Fry fritters for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown and puffed up.
Using a slotted spoon, remove fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
